products.name: Paradox (Olivia)
products.note: Conversational recruiting AI; candidate screening; automated scheduling; hiring bias risk

profile_text.body:
Paradox is a software company focused on conversational hiring tools. Its platform is designed to automate recruiting tasks including candidate screening, interview scheduling, and onboarding, with the stated goal of moving candidates more quickly through the hiring process.

The company's central AI product is an assistant called Olivia, which handles recruiting automation so that human staff can spend less time on administrative tasks. Paradox describes itself as committed to using AI in ways that are transparent, explainable, fair, accountable, secure, and safe, and states that any AI it deploys is thoroughly vetted against those principles. The site tracks Olivia under the HR and Talent AI category, with noted capabilities including conversational recruiting, candidate screening, automated scheduling, and hiring bias risk considerations.

No litigation, SEC filings, MCP server registrations, or patent records are present in the held facts for this company.
